stories.title: Claude unifies connectors and skills under Plugins
stories.summary: Claude announced a unified Plugins experience for connectors, skills and plugins, available on Free, Pro, Max and Ultra. Team and Enterprise rollouts follow later.
stories.insight: Package a recurring workflow with its tool access and instructions, then check how permissions behave when shared.

stories.title: Figma brings its agent to FigJam and Slides
stories.summary: The Figma agent can use connectors and attachments to organize existing material on a FigJam board or turn documents into a draft presentation, with further brand-based refinement.
stories.insight: Try a campaign brief through a workshop board and deck, checking information selection and brand consistency.

stories.title: fal adds Recraft image generation and vectorization
stories.summary: fal announced Recraft V4.1 Flash V2 and Vectorize Pro for image generation and raster-to-SVG conversion, highlighting text-heavy designs and detailed shapes. These are vendor-described capabilities.
stories.insight: Check typography, curves and editability on actual brand assets before using the output for print or motion.

stories.title: Google expands personal context in AI Mode
stories.summary: Google is beginning an opt-in rollout connecting Wallet to Personal Intelligence in Search, with Drive and Gemini connections following in coming weeks. Wallet access is read-only.
stories.insight: Record account and connection settings when evaluating search visibility, since personalized results can differ between users.

stories.title: Z.ai introduces GLM-5.4 for visual coding
stories.summary: GLM-5.4 introduces a looped architecture and vision capabilities for coding and broader creation tasks. It is available through Coding Plan. Z.ai says API access awaits safety evaluation and weights will be released separately.
stories.insight: Compare working results on a task with screenshots and verify availability in the coding tool being used.

stories.title: OpenAI launches OpenWorks for U.S. small businesses
stories.summary: OpenWorks funds local AI partners to help independently owned U.S. small businesses implement projects and build skills. The pilot is free for participating businesses, with in-person work and workshops expected from partners.
stories.insight: The program offers a reference for teaching through concrete business tasks and measuring independent use after support ends.

stories.title: Simon Willison releases datasette-charts
stories.summary: The new Datasette charting plugin aims to select appropriate visualizations automatically. Willison provides a browser demo and describes building the initial prototype with assistance from Claude Fable 5.2.
stories.insight: Use campaign data to inspect aggregation, units and missing values before relying on an automatically selected chart.

stories.title: Sarvam launches a context-aware dictation API
stories.summary: Sarvam Dictate combines speech transcription with text refinement for English and 22 Indian languages, and accepts contextual names and specialized vocabulary from the calling application.
stories.insight: Test dictated briefs for proper nouns, numbers, negations and self-corrections to check whether the intended meaning survives.

stories.title: Vercel introduces Audited ZDR on AI Gateway
stories.summary: The new label requires independent testing of a provider’s zero-data-retention claims and publication of the audit report. Vercel says launch partners Baseten, Modal and Wafer have begun audits.
stories.insight: Check the specific provider, endpoint and report status to understand whether the route in use is covered.

stories.title: DeepMind pairs agent teams with formal verification
stories.summary: Gemini agent teams proposed quantum-algorithm improvements checked with Lean. DeepMind is releasing the library and verified solutions. The results concern estimated resources for future quantum computations.
stories.insight: The workflow illustrates how generated proposals can travel with checkable evidence and reusable verification artifacts.
